# frozen_string_literal: true
# rbs_inline: enabled
require "wardite"

# @rbs directory: String
# @rbs name: String
# @rbs return: Wardite::Efflorescence::VM
def vm_for(directory, name)
  instance = File.open("#{directory}/#{name}.wasm", "rb") do |file|
    Wardite::BinaryLoader.load_from_buffer(file, enable_wasi: false)
  end
  Wardite::Efflorescence::VM.new(instance, disabled_optimizations: [:inline, :frames])
end

# @rbs expected: Integer
# @rbs actual: Integer?
# @rbs return: void
def check(expected, actual)
  raise "checksum #{actual} != #{expected}" unless expected == actual
end

directory = ARGV.fetch(0)
reset = vm_for(directory, "reset")
protocol = vm_for(directory, "protocol")
edges = vm_for(directory, "edges")
inlined = vm_for(directory, "inline")
3.times do
  [0, 1, 123, 0xffffffff].each do |seed|
    check((seed * 128) % 0x100000000, reset.call_unboxed("run", [seed]))
    check(930, reset.call_unboxed("recursive", [30]))
    trapped = false
    begin
      reset.call_unboxed("fail", [])
    rescue Wardite::Unreachable
      trapped = true
    end
    raise "missing trap" unless trapped
    check((seed * 128) % 0x100000000, reset.call_unboxed("run", [seed]))
    check(((seed + 18) % 0x100000000) ^ ((9 * seed - 1) % 0x100000000), protocol.call_unboxed("run", [seed]))
    check(0xffffffff, protocol.call_unboxed("alias", [seed]))
    check(492, protocol.call_unboxed("mutual", [30]))
    check((seed + 495) % 0x100000000, edges.call_unboxed("two", [30, seed]))
    check((seed + 555) % 0x100000000, edges.call_unboxed("three", [30, seed]))
    check(313, edges.call_unboxed("permuted", [17, 23, 31]))
    check((9 * seed) % 0x100000000, edges.call_unboxed("duplicate", [seed]))
    check((seed + 1) % 0x100000000, inlined.call_unboxed("snapshot", [seed]))
    check((10 * seed) % 0x100000000, inlined.call_unboxed("loop", [10, seed]))
    check(seed, inlined.call_unboxed("void", [seed]))
  end
end
puts "validation ok"

(module
  (func $leaf (param i32 i32) (result i32) (local i32 i32)
    block
      local.get 0 i32.eqz br_if 0
      local.get 1 local.set 2
      i32.const 99 local.set 3
    end
    local.get 2 local.get 3 i32.add
    block (result i32)
      local.get 1 i32.const 13 i32.shr_u
      local.get 0 br_if 0
      drop local.get 1 i32.const 7 i32.shl
    end
    i32.xor)
  (func $sum (param i32) (result i32) (local i32)
    block
      local.get 0 br_if 0
      local.get 1 return
    end
    local.get 0 local.set 1
    local.get 0 i32.const 1 i32.sub call $sum
    local.get 1 i32.add)
  (func (export "run") (param i32) (result i32)
    i32.const 1 local.get 0 call $leaf drop
    i32.const 0 local.get 0 call $leaf)
  (func (export "recursive") (param i32) (result i32)
    local.get 0 call $sum
    i32.const 0 call $sum i32.add
    local.get 0 call $sum i32.add)
  (func (export "fail")
    i32.const 1 i32.const 123 call $leaf drop
    unreachable))

runner_source:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess

base = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
measured = json.loads((base / "final/results.json").read_text())
entry = base / "validation/driver.rb"
report = {"driver_source": entry.read_text(), "driver_sha256": hashlib.sha256(entry.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          "fixtures": {}, "variants": []}
for source in (base / "validation").glob("*.wat"):
    report["fixtures"][source.stem] = {"source": source.read_text(), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
environment = dict(os.environ, SPINEL_GC_STRESS="1", SPINEL_GC_VERIFY="1", SPINEL_GC_STATS="1")
for name, snapshot in measured["snapshots"].items():
    directory = base / "final" / name
    generated, obj, binary = [directory / f"validation{suffix}" for suffix in [".c", ".o", ""]]
    spinel = ["spinel", "-I" + str(directory / "lib"), "--strict-require", "-O2", "--no-line-map",
              "-c", str(entry), "-o", str(generated)]
    with (directory / "validation-spinel.log").open("w") as log:
        subprocess.run(spinel, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
    code = generated.read_text()
    body = re.search(r"^static [^\n]+sp_(?:Wardite__Efflorescence__)?VM_execute_flat\([^;\n]*\) \{.*?(?=^static |\Z)", code, re.M | re.S).group()
    assert "SP_GC_ENTRY_PTR(lv_instructions)" in body
    assert not re.search(r"sp_PolyArray_|sp_pd_[a-f0-9]+\(", body)
    if "c_root_elision" in name:
        edited, count = re.subn(r"(sp_IntArray \*(_t\d+) = lv_instructions; )SP_GC_ROOT\(\2\);( sp_int _t\d+ = (?:lv_pc|sp_int_add\(lv_pc, [123]LL\));)", r"\1\3", body)
        assert count == 38, count
        generated.write_text(code.replace(body, edited, 1))
    artifact = snapshot["artifacts"]["worker"]
    compile_command = [str(generated) if arg == str(directory / "worker.c") else str(obj) if arg == str(directory / "worker.o") else arg for arg in artifact["compile_command"]]
    link_command = [str(obj) if arg == str(directory / "worker.o") else str(binary) if arg == str(directory / "worker") else arg for arg in artifact["link_command"]]
    with (directory / "validation-clang.log").open("w") as log:
        subprocess.run(compile_command, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
        subprocess.run(link_command, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
    result = subprocess.run([str(binary), str(base / "validation")], env=environment, capture_output=True, text=True)
    (directory / "validation.stdout").write_text(result.stdout)
    (directory / "validation.stderr").write_text(result.stderr)
    counts = re.findall(r"\[gc\] (\d+) collections", result.stderr)
    report["variants"].append({"variant": name, "returncode": result.returncode, "stdout": result.stdout,
        "stderr": result.stderr, "collections": int(counts[-1]) if counts else 0,
        "environment": {key: environment[key] for key in ["SPINEL_GC_STRESS", "SPINEL_GC_VERIFY", "SPINEL_GC_STATS"]},
        "spinel_command": spinel, "compile_command": compile_command, "link_command": link_command,
        "binary_sha256": hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
    (base / "validation/results.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(name, result.returncode, result.stdout.strip(), "collections", report["variants"][-1]["collections"], flush=True)
    assert result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout == "validation ok\n" and counts and int(counts[-1]) > 0

    check(0xffffffff, protocol.call_unboxed("alias", [seed]))

# Exercise allocation/exception paths with the current instruction buffer held
# only by the normal VM roots. Check recovery in the same VM and native process.
function = simple.ir.function_at(0)
original = function.bytecode
3.times do
  [-1000000, 1000000].each do |target|
    function.install_code([8, target, 0, 0], function.calls)
    caught = false
    begin
      simple.call_unboxed("run", [])
    rescue IndexError
      caught = true
    end
    raise "missing invalid PC error" unless caught
    function.install_code(original, function.calls)
    check(42, simple.call_unboxed("run", []))
  end
  function.install_code([11, 0, 0, 0], function.calls)
  check(0, simple.call_unboxed("run", []))
  function.install_code(original, function.calls)
  check(42, simple.call_unboxed("run", []))
